config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. An Attestwire API key. Five of the nine tools work without it; validate_invoice, validate_invoice_xml, generate_invoice and get_upgrade_link require one. The issue_api_key tool mints a free key (100 documents/month, no card), but minting does not authenticate a live connection: save the key, configure it here, and reconnect.
